_doc: The front page's 'Featured' row (tools/build.py picks it on every build): only skills that work in Emkay (included, or tried and working). First the new and recently updated ones (klondike-mercantile's is_new_repo / is_recently_updated), newest first, at most 'max_fresh'; then 'pinned' ones, if any; last the skill of the week, which changes every ISO week among the other working skills. 'colors' are each category's card gradient.
